# Desktop Web Widget

> Desktop Web Widget is a Windows desktop application for pinning live web pages as movable, resizable, snappable desktop widgets.

Official website: https://desktop-web-widget.martinsulak.dev/
Support: https://desktop-web-widget.martinsulak.dev/support
Terms: https://desktop-web-widget.martinsulak.dev/terms
Privacy: https://desktop-web-widget.martinsulak.dev/privacy
Creator: Martin Sulak, https://martinsulak.dev/

## Product Summary

Desktop Web Widget lets Windows users create live desktop widgets from websites and web apps. Users can add a URL, move and resize the widget, snap it to guides, adjust opacity, change layer order, save layouts as presets, import or export layouts, and lock the workspace.

The app is useful for:

- Live web widgets on Windows 10 and Windows 11
- Personal desktop dashboards
- Market dashboards and crypto price pages
- Monitoring dashboards and status pages
- Documentation, notes, and planning boards
- Video embeds and media pages
- Always-visible web tools

## Key Features

- Multiple independent desktop web widgets
- Live interactive website rendering
- Edit mode and locked mode
- Optional interaction while locked
- Snapping guides for screen edges, center lines, and neighboring widgets
- Opacity and layer controls
- Layout presets, import, and export
- Standard Windows installer
- One-time purchase, no subscription

## Pricing

## Technical Notes

Desktop Web Widget is a Windows productivity app. It does not require Node.js, command-line setup, browser extensions, or programming knowledge for end users. Some websites may restrict loading inside desktop app browser views due to DRM, enterprise policy, login requirements, or anti-embedding behavior.
